description:
After a hit VR dating sim takes the world by storm, a game company rushes to develop its adult-only follow-up. When the original tester falls ill, Jung Soohyun steps in—only for Kim Dowon to accidentally log in on the same account, triggering a system error that traps them both in the game. The only way out? Raise Dowon’s Affection to 100%. But according to the strategy guide, the most effective method is… sexual touching. Things get complicated after they sleep together, and just as tensions rise, a new romanceable character—Lee Jaehee—appears. Now Soohyun has to choose a path to escape—but who will he clear the game with? *(Source: Lezhin US)*
